claims: Georgia defeated Lithuania 2-0 in an international friendly match.
The Georgia-Lithuania international friendly match took place on March 29, 2026.
The Georgia-Lithuania international friendly match was held at the Steponas Darius ir Stasys Girenas Stadium in Kaunas.
Mikautadze scored both goals for Georgia.
The Georgia-Lithuania match featured PSG forward Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
The Georgia-Lithuania friendly was part of the 2026 March international window.
